alive.last_commit_message:
fix(mcp-scan): keep findings that omit optional level/suggestion tags (#744)

* fix(mcp-scan): keep findings that omit optional level/suggestion tags

_parse_vuln_block only requires title/desc/risk_type, but level.strip() and suggestion.strip() ran unconditionally on fields the model may omit. The resulting AttributeError was swallowed by the outer except and the whole finding was silently dropped - the opposite of the tolerant parsing the function documents. Default level and suggestion to empty strings when absent so those findings are kept.

Co-authored-by: generaltony007 <144252170+GeneralTony007@users.noreply.github.com>

* test(mcp-scan): cover vuln findings that omit optional tags

Cover the four parsing cases: a finding without level and suggestion is kept with empty defaults, a finding with level but no suggestion is kept, a finding missing a required field is still dropped, and extract_result returns the first finding.

Co-authored-by: generaltony007 <144252170+GeneralTony007@users.noreply.github.com>
